source: Entergy Texas monthly transmission construction progress report to the PUC, June 2025 (Project No. 57477, item 185), and Entergy Texas project pages (entergytexas.com/transmission, STEP Ahead filings, updated Dec 2025)
note: Entergy Texas is the MISO part of Texas (Southeast Texas). Since July 2025 the monthly reports go to the PUC's Compliance Reporting Portal, so the June 2025 report is the last full list on the public Interchange; newer projects come from Entergy's project pages. 138 kV and up, built since the window opens or due within 5 years. Kept by hand.
